allsight.name: Allsight
allsight.description: Isn't foold by illusions or invisibility.

seismicsense.name: Seismicsense
seismicsense.description: Can see anything touching ground it is touching.

telepath.name: Telepathy
telepath.description: Can see anything that can think.

defend.name: Defend
defend.description: Use defense weapons to block attacks

berserk.name: Berserk
berserk.description: Can't take the Cast Action or Focus, it can't be Frightened, and it doesn't make Morale Checks.

burning.name: Burning
burning.description: A die roll indicates damage it takes at the start of its turns, unless an appropriate action is taken to end it (such as dousing fire).

charmed.name: Charmed
charmed.description: It can't willingly attack the charmer.

confused.name: Confused
confused.description: Its Checks and Saves have Hinder, and Saves against its Actions have Favor.

dazed.name: Dazed
dazed.description: It can't Focus or Move unless it uses an Action to do so.

fatigued.name: Fatigued
fatigued.description: Fatigue is measured from 0 to 5 with the following rules: - Each Fatigue occupies an Item Slot. - At 3 or ore Fatigue, it can't Rush. - At 5 Fatigue, it dies.

frightened.name: Frightened
frightened.description: It has a -2 penalty to damage it deals.

grappling.name: Grappling
grappling.description: Physically causing a Target to be Restrained by using your body is Grappling. A Being that is physically restraining a Target has its Speed halved, unless the Target is smaller.

incapacitated.name: Incapacitated
incapacitated.description: It can't Focus or use its Actions or Move, fails all Might and Dexterity Checks, and is Vulnerable.

invisible.name: Invisible
invisible.description: It can't be seen by normal senses, and thos that can't see it act as Blinded for Checks and Saves involving it.

paralyzed.name: Paralyzed
paralyzed.description: It is Incapacitated and its Speed is 0.

prone.name: Prone
prone.description: You can either drop or stand from Prone by using 10' of Speed. While Prone: Speed cost is halved, it cannot Rush, and is Vulnerable for the purposes of Melee Attacks and Dodge Checks.

restrained.name: Restrained
restrained.description: It is Vulnerable and its Speed is 0.

sickened.name: Sickened
sickened.description: It has a -2 penalty to any healing it receives. Additional effects may be indicated by the cause of the Sickness.

suffocating.name: Suffocating
suffocating.description: Beings begin Suffocating after not breathing for 1 Minute. Heroes: Each Round, while Suffocating, roll a d8. If the result is equal to or greater than your Might, gain 1 Fatigue. Enemies: Each Round, while Suffocating, gain 1 Fatigue.

unconscious.name: Unconscious
unconscious.description: It is Blinded, Incapacitated, and Prone. Close Attacks Targeting it always Crit.

vulnerable.name: Vulnerable
vulnerable.description: Its attacks and Saves against attacks have Hinder. Attacks targeting it and Saves against its attacks have Favor.

warded.name: Warded
warded.description: The Target has +1 Armor. You must spend 1 Mana per Target to Focus on this Spell, even for willing Targets.  Upcast: When the Target takes damage from an attack or Cast, you can upcast this Spell to make a Cast Check to reduce the damage taken by 1d6 per Mana spent on the upcast if you pass.

exalted.name: Exalted
exalted.description: Targets gain a +1 bonus to each damage die they deal and to Will Saves against Frightened. This bonus is doubled if a Hellspawn or Undead is the attack's Target or the one forcing the Save.

blessed.name: Blessed
blessed.description: For the duration, Targeted Objects count as Silvered, and Targeted Beings of your choice have a d4 bonus to Saves. Further, if the Target is freestanding water, it permanently becomes holy water.

marked.name: Marked
marked.description: A Hunter has marked this target.

hexed.name: Hexed
hexed.description: A Witch has Hexed this target.

luck.name: Luck
luck.description:
You can spend 1 Luck to do the following:
Advantage: Grant Favor on a d20 roll.
Fluke: Reroll an unresolved die you rolled.
Plot Armor (variant): Once per Round, if you are reduced to 0 HP, you can spend 1 Luck to regain d6 HP.

studied.name: Studied Die
studied.description: You can spend a Studied die to gain Favor on a d20 roll you make in the next day. You must do so before the d20 roll resolves. You lose any unspent Studied dice after a day.

arcana.name: Arcana
arcana.description: Application and knowledge of magic. Used by Maguses and Wizards to Cast.

brawl.name: Brawl
brawl.description: Exerting physical force. Used for Grapples, Shoves, and attacks with Brawl Weapons.

craft.name: Craft
craft.description: Your skill to appraise, make, and attack with Items that aren’t conventional Weapons.

detect.name: Detect
detect.description: Reflexively sensing danger and avoiding being surprised.

finesse.name: Finesse
finesse.description: Coordination and subtlety. Used pickpocket, lockpick, and attacks with Finesse Weapons.

influence.name: Influence
influence.description: Social ability of coercion, deception, or negotiation. Used by Sorcerers to Cast.

leadership.name: Leadership
leadership.description: Social motivation and diplomacy. Used by Revelators to Cast.

mysticism.name: Mysticism
mysticism.description: Understanding of the supernatural. Used by Druids, Luminaries, and Witches to Cast.

performance.name: Performance
performance.description: Cultural talent and ability to inspire awe.

sneak.name: Sneak
sneak.description: Concealing your location, attempting to sneak up on a Being you are aware of.

survival.name: Survival
survival.description: Tracking and a knowledge of beasts, plants, and other aspects of nature.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: Ignores Flanked for attacks. You can reduce its die one size to hit another Target within reach per size reduction.

defense.name: Defense
defense.description: Once per Round, you gain its damage die as Armor against an Action.

grapple.name: Grapple
grapple.description: Can Grapple with the Attack Check.

keen.name: Keen
keen.description: Crits 1 lower on the Attack Check.

thrown.name: Thrown
thrown.description: Can throw attack to Near, or Far with Hinder. Can be drawn from the Inventory as a part of the attack. You can use this Property if you aren't Trained with it.

brawl.name: Brawl
brawl.description: Can use Brawl to attack. The hand is free while Equipped.

ranged.name: Ranged
ranged.description: Can use Ranged to attack. Close attacks are Hindered.

steel.name: Standard
steel.description: Standard materials with no additional properties.

steel2.name: Steel
steel2.description: Standard steel with no additional properties.

adamant.name: Adamant
adamant.description: Occupies +1 Slot. +1 to Armor (if Armor) or Weapon damage (if Weapon).

mythral.name: Mythral
mythral.description: Counts as 1 less Slot to Equip, and Weapons decrease the damage die one size.

orichalcum.name: Orichalcum
orichalcum.description: Counts as 1 more Slot to Equip, and Weapons increase the damage die one size.

gold.name: Gold
gold.description: Damage die is a countdown die. Armor decreases by 1 after taking damage, breaking at 0.

aura.name: Aura
aura.description: 10' radius from you, affecting Targets of your choice within.

cone.name: Cone
cone.description: 15' cone Area in front of you.

imbue.name: Imbue
imbue.description: Choose a Weapon within Far. You can Cast the Spell against its attack Targets by spending 1 Mana per Target, using the Attack Check for the Cast Check. This is one damage instance, meaning Armor only applies to the total damage.

glyph.name: Glyph
glyph.description: Creates a 5’ square glyph on a Target you can see, where no other glyph is within Close. The Spell is Cast in a 5’ cube from the glyph when you choose, then the glyph disappears.

line.name: Line
line.description: 5' wide, 30' long, 10' tall Area. Expanding the width by 5' or height by up to 10' doubles the Cost.

remote.name: Remote
remote.description: An ambience or bolt on a Target.
